issues.where: the wading animals in the center and right
issues.what: necks meet torsos at a hard disconnected cylinder step, legs are rigid angular rods with sharp kinks, wing sails have jagged low-poly edges, and nothing on their legs is wet
issues.fix: sculpt continuous organic neck-to-torso and joint transitions, add fine feather or membrane detail along the wing edges, and add wet darkening and water droplets to the lower legs

issues.where: the splash around the right animal's lowered head
issues.what: the spray reads as disconnected flat white dots and fuzzy grey discs in mid-air while the head filaments look like rigid translucent strips cutting into the water
issues.fix: replace the dot particles and flat strips with a physically simulated splash of varied fine droplets, light-catching mist, and wet clinging filaments

issues.where: the cliff rock face filling the left half of the frame
issues.what: the close-up rock texture is heavily smeared, soft, and glossy like melted plastic with pure black crevices
issues.fix: replace the stretched cliff material with high-resolution multi-scale rock displacement, rough mineral micro-detail, and bounced ambient light in the crevices

issues.where: the clinging creature along the cliff face
issues.what: the body and limbs look like a smooth clay CG model with blotchy procedural spots, flat-card tendrils, no contact shadow on the rock, and no grit or moisture from the cliff
issues.fix: add fine organic surface detail, subsurface scattering, wet and gritty weathering, grounded contact shadows, and volumetric tendrils that conform to the rock surface

issues.where: the foreground boulder on the bottom left (also visible in set-A-08.png bottom-right and set-A-09.png left)
issues.what: the rock surface shows an obvious repeating woven-grid tiling pattern and a visible UV seam near the bottom-left ridge
issues.fix: replace the tiled shader with non-repeating high-resolution stone texturing and seamless tri-planar or sculpted displacement

issues.where: the two wading animals on the mid-right shore
issues.what: the wing-spreading animal appears ghostly and semi-transparent like an alpha-blended card, the rightmost splash is a cluster of flat white spikes, and the standing animals lack grounding shadows
issues.fix: render solid opaque anatomy with natural feather or membrane translucency, simulate a real water splash, and ground every animal with contact shadows and reflections

issues.where: the foreground boulders and water in the right panel
issues.what: the foreground boulder has a sharp faceted polygon ridge and stretched texture, and the water is a flat grey sheet with no foam, meniscus, or darkened wet edge where it meets the rock
issues.fix: subdivide and displace the boulder silhouette to remove facets, fix the texture stretching, and add a darkened wet band, meniscus, and subtle foam at the waterline

issues.where: the distant shoreline surf and mist in the top-left and top-right panels
issues.what: the breaking surf reads as a bright flat vertical-striped card topped with repetitive grey puff-blobs
issues.fix: replace the flat surf band and puff cards with volumetric breaking wave spray and soft light-catching sea mist

issues.where: the wet sand and pebbles across both panels
issues.what: the sand surface shows a repeating cross-hatched moire bump pattern and small pebbles sit with dark rings and no natural sand buildup or water edge
issues.fix: break up the sand micro-normal to eliminate the repeating pattern and blend pebbles into the wet sand with water meniscuses and sediment edges

issues.where: the water and dark shadow patch in the bottom-right panel
issues.what: the water reads as smooth grey plastic with a hard-edged flat dark patch and no depth, foam, or shoreline transition
issues.fix: add realistic water depth, sky-driven specular variation, softer shadow falloff, and a wet shoreline edge

issues.where: the close-up cliff crops in the top-left and bottom-right panels and the creature torso in the top-right panel
issues.what: at native size the rock dissolves into blurry glossy streaks with pure black hollows, and the creature torso shows a sharp intersecting polygon seam at the limb joint
issues.fix: increase rock surface resolution and matte roughness, lift pure black crevices with bounce light, and weld and blend the creature limb-to-torso mesh

issues.where: the water surface and pebbles in both panels
issues.what: the water is flat grey with procedural concentric rings around the head filaments, and small pebbles float or clip into the surface with dark halos and no refraction
issues.fix: add water clarity, refracted submerged rock bases, natural irregular ripples, and foam where the filaments break the surface

issues.where: the hazy sky and distant rock spires in the top-right and bottom-left panels
issues.what: a faint fine screen-door dithering grid is visible across the uniform grey-beige fog tint
issues.fix: remove the dithering grid artifact and add subtle atmospheric depth and light variation through the haze
